description: India - Hydropower Database is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Hydropower", published or maintained by Samuel Law (International Hydropower Association). Building upon the dataset of Indian hydropower dams available on energydata.info, IHA updated this dataset with its own global database of hydropower stations and other publicly available data sources including India Central Water Commission's National Register of Large Dams (NRLD), Central Electricity Authority of India’s annual reports and station level information from utility owners. Coverage: India. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy access, Hydropower, Water. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
